data.r_code: mrf_export(frame = cc, score = p, decision = alert, coef = coef(fit), train_rows = idx)
data.explanation: I chose the 'cc' data frame as the frame because it contains the raw inputs as the model saw them. The 'p' vector was used for scores, which contains the predicted probabilities for the test set. The 'alert' vector was included for decisions, matching the length of the scores. The 'idx' vector was used for training rows as it represents the indices of the rows used to fit the model.
